scope.granularity: One record per guide, FAQ category, manual section, troubleshooting module, role track, or intent category. source_item_count preserves the atomic authored-unit count.
scope.included: Static, complete, non-tenant help/FAQ/manual/troubleshooting content present in the canonical commit.
scope.excluded: Tickets, chat/free text, dynamic tenant/user/tutorial records, editable database rows, secrets, tokenized URLs, drafts, derived duplicate exports, and metadata-only resources.

classification_meaning.shared-core: Candidate for a product-neutral ecosystem article after route/brand/claim normalization.
classification_meaning.caremetric-emr-overlay: Keep scoped to CareMetric EMR unless an editor explicitly extracts a reusable core.

scope.route_context_policy: Only static route templates are present. No query, hash, patient, user, tenant, organization, or free-text context is included.

items.title: AI Note Generation & Ambient Scribe
items.summary: CareMetric AI offers three note-creation modes: Traditional (manual SOAP), Guided (structured template with AI suggestions), and Ambient (AI listens to the patient encounter and drafts the note automatically). All modes support AI-assisted coding, MDM calculation, and documentation quality scoring.

items.title: Automation Rules Engine
items.summary: The Rules Engine lets practice administrators create automated workflows triggered by clinical or administrative events — send a follow-up SMS after a visit, trigger a PA request when a medication is prescribed, or route a task to the biller when a note is signed. No coding required.

items.title: Billing & Claims Submission
items.summary: The Billing module covers the full revenue cycle: charge capture, claim scrubbing, electronic submission via ClaimMD, ERA/EOB auto-posting, denial management, and patient collections. AI automates claim validation, flags probable denials before submission, and drafts appeal letters.

items.title: Chronic Care Management (CCM)
items.summary: The CCM module supports Medicare's Chronic Care Management program, enabling billing of CPT 99490, 99491, 99487, and 99489 for monthly care management time with patients who have two or more chronic conditions. The AI automates time tracking, care plan generation, and billing readiness calculations.

items.title: Compliance & Audit Logs
items.summary: The Compliance module provides comprehensive audit logging of every user action, PHI access event, and system transaction. It supports HIPAA compliance reporting, OIG exclusion checks, documentation audits, and regulatory reporting. AI analyzes audit patterns to detect anomalous access.

items.title: Dashboard
items.summary: The Dashboard is your personalized command center — the first screen after login. It surfaces today's schedule, urgent tasks, unread messages, billing alerts, and AI-driven clinical nudges. Every role sees a tailored view based on their permissions.

items.title: Prescriptions & Medications

items.title: Integrations (Labs, Payers, FHIR)
items.summary: CareMetric AI integrates with labs, devices, payers, clearinghouses, pharmacies, HIEs, and external EHRs via HL7 v2, FHIR R4, and proprietary APIs. The Integration Hub is the central configuration point for all third-party connections.

items.title: Messaging, SMS & Tasks
items.summary: The Messaging & Tasks module unifies internal staff messaging, patient portal inbox, two-way SMS, care team group messaging, and structured task management. AI triage automatically prioritizes incoming messages by clinical urgency.

items.title: Patient Chart
items.summary: The Patient Chart is the longitudinal clinical record for every patient, organized into tabbed sections: Overview, Vitals, Medications, Problem List, Labs, Documents, Orders, and Billing. The AI continuously analyzes chart data to surface insights, flag drug interactions, and suggest coding improvements.

items.title: Patient Portal
items.summary: The Patient Portal gives patients secure online access to health records, messaging, appointment requests, bill pay, lab results, and intake forms. Data entered by patients flows directly into the chart. Family proxy access supports caregivers managing dependents.

items.title: Prior Authorization
items.summary: The Prior Authorization module streamlines submission, tracking, and appeal of insurance prior authorizations. AI drafts clinical justification letters, extracts relevant chart documentation, and monitors approval status. The FHIR PA Hub supports electronic submission to FHIR-enabled payers.

items.title: Reporting & Analytics
items.summary: Reporting & Analytics provides real-time and historical data across clinical quality, financial performance, staff productivity, and population health. Dashboards are role-specific and configurable. AI-powered predictive analytics forecast revenue, no-show rates, and chronic disease deterioration.

items.title: Scheduling & Calendar
items.summary: The Scheduling module provides a full-featured calendar for booking, rescheduling, and managing appointments across multiple providers and locations. It includes online self-scheduling, automated SMS/email reminders, waitlist management, and integrated telehealth booking.

items.title: Telehealth (Twilio Video)
items.summary: CareMetric AI's telehealth module is powered by Twilio Video. It provides browser-based HD video visits that integrate directly with scheduling, note documentation, and billing. No patient app download is required. Ambient scribe works during telehealth visits.

items.title: User & Role Management
items.summary: User and Role Management controls who accesses what in CareMetric AI. Role-based access control (RBAC) supports predefined roles and custom permission sets. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) can be enforced organization-wide via SMS or authenticator app.

excluded_sources.reason: Tenant-generated jobs include organization_id, user_id, free-text prompt, draft/in-progress state, and signed asset URLs. No rows were queried.
Mutable database content has no governed publication status in this surface. No rows were queried.
Requests and conversations can contain user, tenant, patient, and free-text data. No records were queried.
Twenty marketing cards contain title/description only; generated downloads repeat that short metadata and have no authored guide body.
Three historical webinar cards have metadata but no source video or tutorial body.
Twenty-three volatile marketing FAQ snippets duplicate canonical FAQ themes and require pricing, security, SLA, and compliance review.
Twelve derived text exports duplicate Markdown sources and would create duplicate search results.
Five generated indexes/checklists/comparison pages are derived or metadata-only; production-readiness-checklist.html explicitly says NOT READY.
Seven binary responsibility, security, consent, and signature policy forms are governed documents rather than Help Center articles.
Build/distribution README rather than end-user help content.
Internal tutorial-generation operations and infrastructure documentation, not customer tutorial content.

remote_text_asset_scan.scope: All UTF-8 .md, .txt, and .html files under public/docs/pdf at the canonical commit.
remote_text_asset_scan.note: Credential-like matches in INTEGRATION_SETUP_GUIDE.md were type syntax or explicit placeholders; values were not copied.

draft_handling.semantic_uses_of_draft_not_treated_as_dr: Claim status, appeal drafting, and AI note drafting references remain eligible content.

recommendations: Start the Hub migration with the shared-core records, but first remove CareMetric-specific routes and fact-check security, support-SLA, retention, uptime, vendor, and training claims.
Use the in-app FAQ, five role quick-start tracks, and sixteen manual modules as the CareMetric EMR pilot overlay; they are the most task-oriented sources.

Reconcile the 200-question comprehensive FAQ, 80-question public FAQ, 20-question in-app FAQ, and 28 chatbot intents into one canonical question registry with aliases before publishing to avoid duplicate and contradictory answers.

Require owner, status, version, last-reviewed-at, and next-review-at metadata for every migrated record; route all clinical, billing, regulatory, pricing, and security claims through subject-matter review.
Normalize contact blocks to support@caremetric.ai and +1 877 521 2890 at render time instead of embedding contact details in article bodies.
Create a first-party video registry keyed to content_key so one approved HeyGen/video asset can be reused by every product overlay.
Do not migrate tutorial_jobs. The repository contains a tenant-generated tutorial pipeline, not a reusable static customer tutorial catalog.
Keep launcher context limited to product, static route template, and sanitized app version; never add referrer, query, hash, patient, user, tenant, organization, or free-text fields.
